notes.title: Party Quiz goes pay-to-play + future dev plans
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 
PD here!

The moment has arrived. As promised, Party Quiz has transitioned to pay-to-play! To express my gratitude, the game is launching with a generous discount. Grab a copy for your friends and family and help support the continued development of the game ;)

What’s New in This Update?

AI Model Selection: Choose from four adorable AI characters, each with their own unique level of strictness. Experiment and find your favorite!

Important Note About Reviews

Due to the transition to the new pay-to-play model, all previous reviews have been reset. If you’ve bought and enjoyed Party Quiz, leaving a review would mean the world to me and help others discover the game

Plans for the Future

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming to Party Quiz:

In-Client Gameplay (Lobby): Play PQ directly from the client, without a browser
Pack Management Made Easy: View, vote, filter, and download quiz packs directly within the game
Pack Testing Mode: Test quiz packs locally without setting up a full game
Expanded Language Support
Bug Fixes & Quality-of-Life Improvements: Your feedback helps make the game even better.


Your support fuels my passion for making Party Quiz the best it can be. 
As long as people are playing, I’ll keep developing.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Let’s make Party Quiz even more fun together! 🎉

notes.title: Hotfix + Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Well, you really gave me quite a wake-up call (deservedly so!)
It's the perfect time to reflect and figure out what exactly bothered you the most

Plans for the Near Future

The most common complaint I've seen is that it's impossible to connect from within the game itself (there's no lobby). That will be my top priority for the next major patch. I completely understand that playing through a browser isn’t ideal—not to mention how clunky it looks—so I’ll be working on adding a proper lobby!
Note: browser support will remain and players will be free to join using whichever method they prefer

The next big issue was feedback about how unclear the gameplay is. Here’s what I plan to do:
[olist]
 Add more explicit hints in the game (I’ve already included slides for first-time players)
 Host a few tutorial streams to show how the game is intended to be played
 And finally, I’m always available in our Discord to help if anything is unclear. Plus, we’re building a warm community there, so they’ll likely help you out too!
[/olist]

What’s in This Hotfix?

 Fixed the general timer that sometimes disappeared and wouldn’t return.
 Video playback should now be fixed (hopefully!).
 A bunch of small but annoying bugs have been addressed.


I’ll keep you updated on everything, so let’s stay connected!

P.S. And one more thing—please remember that this game is made by a single person. I’m not asking for pity (I chose this path, after all), but I want you to know that my one and only goal has always been to give you a game where you can spend time with friends and family ❤️

notes.title: Party Quiz is Becoming Paid Soon
notes.content:
Hey everyone, PD here!
First off, thank you for being such an awesome community! Watching Party Quiz grow and seeing you all enjoy it with friends and family has been inspiring. Now, as PQ approaches full release, I want to share some important news about the game’s future.

Next week, Party Quiz will move to a pay-to-play model with the price around $7. If you already own the game, it’s yours to keep for free.

Why the change?
Creating a game like Party Quiz isn’t cheap, and I want to share where your support goes:

- AI Host and question generation: These systems rely on external APIs, which come with recurring costs (and trust me, it's not cheap)
- Web page and matchmaking hosting: Keeping the servers running
- Continued development: I want to bring you more features, new content, and exciting updates as we move forward

This small price tag will help cover these expenses and let me keep delivering the quality and fun you deserve

Thank you so much for being here through this journey. Your support means the world to me, and I can’t wait to keep growing Party Quiz together

Cheers,
PD

notes.title: Update 0.22 is now available!
notes.content:
New Features:
> New question type, "revealing clues". In the constructor, you'll be able to set a list of gradually appearing clues that increasingly hint to the correct answer. The more hints are revealed, the fewer points the player will earn
> Small icons indicating the question type and answer have been added in the constructor (text - music - audio - video)
> You can now adjust the text display speed on the board (the audio settings tab)
> After the game ends, buttons "open pack in Steam Workshop" (if available) and "finish game" appear. Some players had been confused about what to do after the game ends
> After the end of a multiple-choice question, the answering player is randomly selected from those who gave the correct answer
> Player names and answers now have character limits

Fixes:
> Question price can no longer be less than 0
> The player score panel now displays all players correctly (previously limited to 8 players)
> Issues with the game freezing during round changes/point change have been fixed
> The cooldown button calculator now affects the player's answer cooldown as well
> Answers given in "auction" or "multiple choice" questions now count towards end-of-game statistics
> The maximum answer time limit has been increased to 60 seconds (previously 30 seconds)
> The player answer field is now correctly cleared after the player gives their answer
> Pack loading is now properly divided into tabs, and loading spins only where packs haven't fully loaded yet
> Wizard avatars have been fixed, their hats are no longer partially transparent when the camera is far away
> The game no longer breaks if a floating point bid is placed during an auction question

notes.title: Update 0.16
notes.content:
New:
- We've introduced age ratings for packs, giving authors the ability to designate their packs as suitable for various age groups: 0+, 12+, 16+, or 18+
- UI sounds now feature slightly randomized pitch variations for a more engaging experience
- In case the auction winner provides the wrong answer, the auction price now resets to the original one
- Players can now use their devices to select the recipient of the cat-in-poke (used to be a Host-only feature)
- Hosts have the option to initiate a final round for all players, ensuring that everyone's score reaches a minimum of 100
- We've streamlined the pack update process by enabling you to update your pack directly from the 'Steam' tab

Fixes:
- The name of the category is now displayed on the main game board if the description is empty
- The time taken to declare game winners has been reduced for a smoother gaming experience
- Multiple-choice questions now correctly subtract score points as intended
- When creating a game, the full Steam pack description is now visible (used to be limited by 200 symbols)
- Question prices of '1000' and more are now displayed correctly on the board
- Answers are now sent only to the host, ensuring a fair game (used to be sent to players too)
- Players can no longer send fake host commands, disrupting the game
- If an auction or cat-in-poke question includes audio, it won't pause when a player begins to answer
- The tense thinking music will no longer play during a multiple-choice audio question
- Multiple achievements have been fixed and improved (Thanks: Tasselfoot)

notes.title: 06/05 Minor Patch

-    A slider that allows you to adjust the speed of the TTS has been added. The available values range from 0.5 to 2.0:

https://i.ibb.co/hcGh96M/Screenshot-2023-06-05-204615.png

In the upcoming patch I plan to enable users to select both Local and Steam packs in the constructor for modifying, adjusting and saving the new packs for future use.
Have a great week ahead of you

notes.title: Patch based on your feedback: v0.3
notes.content:
It's time to release our second minor patch based on your input. Here's the list of changes for today:

[olist]
 You can now click on the Game ID panel to hide/show it. This feature may be useful for streamers or anyone who wants to hide the ID while presenting the game.
 If the player who is choosing the question has been kicked, a new player will now be assigned as the chooser.
 When the host changes the camera while the question is being read, the camera won't automatically change until the end of the question. This is especially useful for close-ups of small displayed pictures and similar situations.
 The 3D font in the studio has been adjusted slightly. Specifically, the distance between letters has been reduced.
 There should be no FPS drops when a lot of players spam the button simultaneously.
 The camera no longer twitches during the final question review.
 The elevator music during the final round now starts only after the question has been read.
 An issue with an Auction question has been fixed: when there were no eligible players to play an Auction, the game was bugging.
 During the round result score point display, there used to be a significant delay between players (2 seconds). This delay has been reduced to maintain a faster pace of the game.
 Characters are now correctly playing their idle animations.
[/olist]

That's all for today, but we encourage you to submit any bugs or suggestions. Rest assured, they will be thoroughly reviewed!

notes.title: First minor patch based on your feedback
notes.content:

We encourage you to send us any bugs or mistakes you notice, since there's always some room for improvement!
